content.text: Two sources back it. Note N09 says Alder confirmed the route changes on Sept 28 to Monday/Wednesday instead of Monday/Thursday, with orders by noon the day before (notes.csv SITE-01 N09 rev1). INV-016 was also delivered on Wednesday 2026-09-30 (invoice_headers.csv SITE-01 INV-016 rev1). The vendor sheet still says Monday, Thursday, last reviewed 2026-09-14, so it looks stale (vendors.csv SITE-01 V1 rev1). The ledger holds this as an assertion from note N09, and nothing has rechecked it. It's informal, so a quick call to Alder would settle it. Do you want me to record a different delivery schedule?
